description: mode=full runs qmd's reranker, and the per-result rerank and blended scores appear in candidate metadata. index_config names the mode and the reranker model, so a run under this mode cannot be compared with a hybrid run by accident.

placeholders.FIXTURE: absolute path of this case's fixture/ directory, which holds the recorded qmd output and the corpus evidence is read from
placeholders.WORKDIR: absolute path of a fresh, writable, empty directory
